test_dtype_of_scalar_literal: test pl.dtype_of returns the correct dtype for scalar literals like integers
test_dtype_of_float_literal: test pl.dtype_of returns Float64 for floating-point literal values
test_dtype_of_string_literal: test pl.dtype_of returns String for string literal values
test_dtype_of_list_literal: test pl.dtype_of returns List(Int64) for list literals containing integers
test_collect_dtype_method: test collect_dtype({}) resolves the dtype from a dtype_of expression result
